title: Observation agent
author: Scott Hom
masthead: A write-up about the assignment: what the brief asked for, how the system meets it, and how it was built. The system's own results, the dashboard and the report, are under The system's output.
note: Reading this with an AI assistant? This site is set up for Claude to read in full. Give it this page's address and ask it anything about the project.
summary: A system that runs inside Claude Code, reads all {{fig:messages_read}} messages of an email archive from Enron, finds the work that recurs, prices what could be automated at $85 an hour, and ties every claim to a message and a verbatim quote. One command runs it; the outputs of one real run are committed with the code. Start with the index page: it maps every requirement of the brief to where it is met and how it is checked.
